inputs: input [batch, 10, N, N] float32, in the mover's frame: 0 horizontal walls, 1 vertical walls, 2 mover pawn, 3 opponent pawn, 4 mover walls left, 5 opponent walls left (both divided by the starting walls), 6 mover goal distance / N, 7 opponent goal distance / N (4.0 where cut off), 8 mover shortest-path cells, 9 opponent shortest-path cells
outputs: policy [batch, 12 + 2 (N-1)^2] probabilities over the mover's actions (12 pawn moves, horizontal walls, vertical walls); value [batch, 1] in [-1, 1] for the mover

strength.anchor: Evan bot: heuristic search, 100 simulations, fresh tree, rated 0
strength.interval_method: Laplace interval of a joint Bradley-Terry fit (quasi-binomial) of all the ladder's games, not adjusted for multiple comparisons
strength.settings: network at 25 simulations, fresh tree, most-visited move
